article.title: Almost all future robot vacuums were just banned by the US government
article.summary: Yesterday the US government announced its was updating its list of banned foreign-made products to include “advanced robotic devices,” and today an FCC spokesperson confirmed that applies to robot vacuums too.

article.title: Robot vacuums are included in US robot ban
article.summary: The United States government has issued a ban on “advanced robotic devices” produced outside of the US, which has been confirmed to include robot vacuums.
article.title_zh: 掃地機器人列入美國機器人禁令

article.title: The FCC’s foreign robot ban declares war on robotic vacuum cleaners
article.summary: TL;DR The FCC’s latest ban on foreign tech has set its aim at “advanced robotic devices.” While the announcement specifically mentioned walking robots, the FCC has now clarified that the ban impacts robot vacuums as well. Current models (despite some clear examples of security risks) won’t be impacted, but future launches may face the ban. The current administration has a complicated relationship with China, to put it mildly, and when it’s not wreaking havoc on the global economy with tariffs , it’s fixating on the latest Chinese tech it wants to ban . This week, that has extended to banning foreign “advanced robotic devices,” but as it turns out, “advanced” may be a much lower bar than you’d think — so low, even robotic vacuums make the cut. article.title: Who wins and who loses after US bans foreign robots?
article.summary: Humanoid robots and four-legged robots made in China fall squarely under a new ban imposed by the US Federal Communications Commission on foreign-made robots. But the sweeping prohibition covers a wide variety of robots manufactured anywhere abroad, including the newest robot vacuum cleaners. article.title_zh: 美國禁止外國機器人後誰贏誰輸?

article.title: Australia’s Social Media Ban Sees Only Small Dip in Teen Users
article.summary: Australia’s social media ban for under-16s led to only a marginal reduction in underage users in its first three months, underscoring the lack of enforcement of the world-first law by major platforms.

article.summary_zh: 澳洲針對 16 歲以下用戶的社交媒體禁令在頭三個月內未成年用戶減少幅度微乎其微，突顯了主要平台對這項世界首創法律的執法不力。

article.summary: On the company’s second-quarter earnings call Wednesday, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said Meta sees a “large enterprise opportunity” spanning AI agents, APIs, compute, and internal software.

article.title: Why your company should (try to) build its own AI SRE
article.summary: Companies ship more code today than ever, thanks to agentic coding tools. For product teams, this accelerated pace of development is a boon. But for site reliability engineers (SREs), the influx of new, machine-written code is not. Why? Because when something breaks, no human fully understands how the underlying system works. Sorting out what went wrong, how to fix it, and how to avoid the problem in the future can be both difficult and time-consuming. All while time constraints remain static, as downtime is no more welcome today than in the past. You can easily burn out your humans by tasking them with sorting out how to fix what agents built; that’s backward. article.title_zh: 為什麼你的公司應該（試著）建立自己的 AI SRE
article.summary_zh: 由於代理編碼工具的出現，公司現在發佈的代碼比以往任何時候都多。雖然這加快了產品團隊的開發速度，但對於現場可靠性工程師（SRE）來說，大量機器生成的代碼帶來了挑戰，因為當出現問題時，沒有人類完全理解代碼的運作方式。

article.title: “The beast needs a cage”: Why PortSwigger’s agentic pentesting is kept safe behind bars
article.summary: As agentic services diversify across the entire enterprise technology stack, the rise of agentic coding tools is being challenged by agentic cyberattack techniques , which, in turn, are spurring a raft of autonomous vulnerability -protection tools and platforms. But cyber protection has many distinct practices and sub-disciplines, so where will agentic autonomy continue to rise next?  Aiming to put agentic AI control into the realm of pentesting is PortSwigger , a company known for its web security testing platform, Burp Suite . The company released the public beta of Burp AT on Wednesday, a new product to bring purpose-built agentic AI to professional pentesting in Burp Suite. article.summary: Spotify is introducing two new features this week including a “Running Mode” that can automatically match songs and playlists to the pace of your workout, as well as “User Notes” which let you leave notes throughout your library to refer to later.

article.title: Why linting alone can’t govern agentic development
article.summary: There’s no question that AI agents are changing software development. They can move from an idea to a working implementation quickly, explore alternatives, and take on larger bodies of work that might otherwise have stayed in the backlog. The opportunity is real. The question now is how to turn that speed into reliable, lasting value. Linting has an important role in that effort. Linters provide fast, local feedback on syntax errors, undefined variables, formatting, and common mistakes. They help teams establish consistent standards without slowing development. In agentic workflows, that immediacy and consistency become even more valuable.
